title: Communication from the City Clerk - Certifying that the petition submitted pursuant to section 37 of the Municipal Home Rule Law seeking to amend the New York City Charter requiring nonpartisan elections using ranked choice voting for ranked choice offices does not comply with the requirements of the law and is therefore ineligible for submission to the New York City Board of Elections.
